response.text:
Here’s a professional follow-up you can send to the vendor. I can send it for you on Monday at 8:00 AM vendor time and notify you once it’s sent — but I need confirmation that I have permission and the ability to send from your account (or you can schedule it yourself). Details and next steps are below.

Draft email (ready to send)

Subject: Follow-up: Delayed Shipment for Order [Order # / PO #] — Request for Updated ETA

Hello [Vendor Contact Name],

I’m following up about shipment for Order [Order # / PO #], which was scheduled to ship on [original ship date]. We have not yet received an update and this delay is beginning to impact our schedule (e.g., [brief impact — production/customer delivery/etc.]).

Please provide the following as soon as possible:
- Updated estimated ship date and delivery ETA
- Reason for the delay
- Whether expedited shipping is available and any additional cost
- A confirmed plan of action and expected confirmation by [desired response date, e.g., within 48 hours]

If you cannot meet a revised timeline, please propose next steps so we can coordinate mitigation on our end.

Thank you for your prompt attention.

Best regards,  
[Your full name]  
[Title]  
[Company]  
[Phone] | [Email]

Notes: attach the purchase order or invoice if you want. Adjust the tone or add specifics (penalties, contract references) if you want a firmer approach.

What I need from you to send/schedule this
- Confirm you want this exact text or supply edits.  
- Confirm vendor contact name and recipient email address.  
- Provide Order # / PO #, original ship date, and the brief impact line you want included.  
- Confirm the time zone for “their time” (vendor time zone) or give the vendor’s city/country.  
- Confirm any CC/BCC addresses and whether to attach the PO/invoice (attach file or say which).  
- Confirm your sending preference:
  - Option A — I have permission and an active email connector to send on your behalf: I will schedule/send Monday at 8:00 AM vendor time and notify you immediately after it goes out.
  - Option B — I do NOT have sending capability / you prefer to send yourself: I’ll give you the exact subject/body and step-by-step scheduling instructions for Gmail or Outlook.

Important: I cannot run background tasks or send the message on a future date unless you explicitly authorize and enable an email-sending tool/connector now. If you want me to send it, reply with the confirmations above and grant/send access details; otherwise I’ll provide the ready-to-use draft and scheduling steps.
